so sánh range: thời gian tập của ai đều hơn
dùng số liệu (6 và 7 phút, 3 và 7 phút)

b.b1e79fc6.de:
These are the times in seconds of two runners in six 100 m races. Runner 1: **12.7, 10.4, 11.4, 10.8, 12.2, 10.9** · Runner 2: **12.5, 11.9, 10.3, 11.6, 10.8, 11.9**
Give reasons for who is the better runner.

tu_kiem.t: so sánh mean của hai người
so sánh range (ai đều sức hơn)
nhớ rằng thời gian ít hơn là chạy nhanh hơn

b.b1e79fc6.bai_mau: Runner 1 is better because their mean time is lower (11.4 s compared with 11.5 s), so they are usually faster. Their ranges are almost the same (2.3 s and 2.2 s), so both runners are about as consistent.

b.1729de6c.de:

a: Player A
b: Player B

Players B and D both have the same average bowling score. Which do you think is the better player? Write a sentence to convince your partner that B or D is better. Use information from the table in your sentence.

tu_kiem.t: nêu B và D có cùng mean (125)
so sánh range: B 36, D 69
dùng số liệu trong bảng để giải thích ai giỏi hơn

b.1729de6c.bai_mau: Player B is better because B and D have the same mean (125), but B’s range is only 36 and D’s range is 69, so B scores about the same every game while D is up and down. You could also argue for D: D’s best games (154 and 160) are higher than any of B’s.

b.67db6fc8.de:

Group 2 có range nhỏ hơn: các bạn cao gần bằng nhau

b.67db6fc8.bai_mau: Group 1 would have some very short and some very tall children, because their heights spread over 25 cm. The children in Group 2 would look more similar in height, because their range is only 14 cm.

nêu được ít nhất hai cặp khác nhau

b.1e21711c.bai_mau: The missing numbers could be 9 and 23, or 10 and 22, because each pair adds up to 32 and 58 + 32 = 90 = 15 × 6.

b.cb96e2a2.de: In your own words, write a definition for each of the three averages and the range.

tu_kiem.t: mode: giá trị xuất hiện nhiều lần nhất
median: giá trị ở giữa sau khi xếp theo thứ tự
mean: tổng chia cho số giá trị
range: lớn nhất trừ nhỏ nhất

b.cb96e2a2.bai_mau: The mode is the value that appears most often. The median is the middle value when the data is in order. The mean is the total of all the values divided by how many values there are. The range is the highest value minus the lowest value.

b.8720f2c2.de:
Correct the mistakes in the sentences below.
a: The mean is the number that appears most often in the set.
b: The mean is all the numbers added up and divided by how many numbers there are.
c: The mean is the middle number when the numbers are put in order.
a: The range is the biggest number in the data set.
b: The range is the middle value between the highest and the lowest.
c: The range is not an average. It shows how spread out the data is.
a: There can be one mode, more than one mode, or no mode at all.
b: There can be one mode or two modes, but never more than two.
c: A set of data always has at least one mode.
a: If the data set has an even number of values, the median is the bigger of the two middle values.
b: If the data set has an even number of values, the median is halfway between the two middle values.
c: If the data set has an even number of values, there is no median.
Now rewrite each of the four sentences yourself so that it is correct.

tu_kiem.t: mean: cộng rồi CHIA cho số giá trị
range không phải là average
có thể có nhiều mode hoặc không có mode
chỉ có một median: nửa đường giữa hai số ở giữa

b.8720f2c2.bai_mau: The mean is all the numbers added up and divided by how many numbers there are. The range is not an average; it shows how spread out the data is. There can be one mode, more than one mode or no mode. If the data set has an even number of values, the median is halfway between the two middle values.

b.f184ca72.de:
The tables below show the rankings for the teams which have qualified for this year’s tournament. The rankings were decided according to the teams’ success over the last four years, with number 1 being the highest ranking. Group A: Qatar 48, Ecuador 44, Senegal 18, Netherlands 8 · Group B: England 5, IR Iran 22, USA 14, Wales 19 · Group C: Argentina 3, Saudi Arabia 53, Mexico 12, Poland 26 · Group D: France 4, Australia 39, Denmark 10, Tunisia 30 · Group E: Spain 6, Costa Rica 34, Germany 11, Japan 24 · Group F: Belgium 2, Canada 43, Morocco 23, Croatia 15 · Group G: Brazil 1, Serbia 25, Switzerland 16, Cameroon 38 · Group H: Portugal 9, Ghana 60, Uruguay 13, Korea Republic 28
Would you use the mean or median in this case to compare the groups? Give a reason for your choice.

tu_kiem.t: chọn rõ mean hoặc median
nêu một lý do cho lựa chọn (ví dụ thứ hạng rất cao / rất thấp như Ghana 60, Brazil 1, hoặc mean dùng mọi đội)
dùng số liệu của ít nhất một bảng đấu (mean và median) để minh hoạ lý do

b.f184ca72.bai_mau: I would use the median. Some groups have one very low-ranked team, like Ghana (60) in Group H, which pulls the mean up to 27.5, but the median (20.5) stays close to the middle teams. The median is not changed much by very large or very small rankings. Someone could choose the mean because it uses every team’s ranking, but one very low-ranked team changes it a lot.

b.82cf16c1.de:
The tables below show the rankings for the teams which have qualified for this year’s tournament. The rankings were decided according to the teams’ success over the last four years, with number 1 being the highest ranking. Explain why this group’s data is so consistent.

The rankings were decided according to the teams’ success over the last four years, with number 1 being the highest ranking. b.f817e0cf.de:
I measured the height of different children in grade 5. Height of children in 5B1: **140 cm, 140 cm, 130 cm, 154 cm, 121 cm** · Height of children in 5B2: **125 cm, 137 cm, 163 cm, 140 cm, 145 cm**
What conclusion can you make from this data?

tu_kiem.t: so sánh mean: 5B2 cao hơn (142 so với 137 cm)
nhận ra median bằng nhau (140 cm)
so sánh range: chiều cao 5B2 chênh nhau nhiều hơn (38 so với 33 cm)

b.bb3724cc.de:
Ahmed calculates: 0.7 + 0.41 = 0.48
He has made a mistake. How can you help him avoid making the same mistake again?

tu_kiem.t: Nêu đúng lỗi: Ahmed không line up the decimal points (cộng 7 tenths với 41 hundredths như cùng hàng).
Nêu cách tránh: viết 0.7 thành 0.70 (trailing zero) rồi cộng theo cột.

b.bb3724cc.bai_mau: Ahmed added 7 and 41 as if they were in the same place. 0.7 is 7 tenths, so line up the decimal points and write it as 0.70. Then 0.70 + 0.41 = 1.11.

b.f6145221.de: Mr. Charlie says, “34.543 decomposed is 30 + 4 + 0.5 + 0.4 + 0.3”. What mistake has he made?

tu_kiem.t: Nêu đúng lỗi: sai place value ở hundredths và thousandths.
Viết được 4 hundredths = 0.04 và 3 thousandths = 0.003.

b.f6145221.bai_mau: He has not got the place value of the hundredths and thousandths correct: the 4 is worth 0.04 and the 3 is worth 0.003.

b.de85253f.nguon: LMS: Decimals – Reasoning and Problem Solving (slide 4)

tu_kiem.t: Tính được A, B, D, E đều bằng 2.123 (chỉ regroup theo cách khác).
Nêu được C bằng 3.13 nên C khác.

b.de85253f.bai_mau: A, B, D and E are all equal to 2.123. They are the same number regrouped in different ways. C is 2 + 1.1 + 0.03 = 3.13, so C is the odd one out.

b.06762f94.nguon: LMS: Decimals – Reasoning and Problem Solving (slide 9)
b.06762f94.de:
Tiny has represented 16.53 + 5.485 on a place value chart. The table shows how many counters Tiny put in each column.
Table (T | O | Tth | Hth | Thths):
- 16.53: 1, 6, 5, 3, 0
- 5.485: 5, 4, 8, 5, 0
What mistake has Tiny made?

tu_kiem.t: Nêu đúng lỗi: Tiny đặt 5.485 lệch một cột sang trái (bảng thành 54.85) vì không line up the decimal points.
Nói được 5.485 là 5 ones, 4 tenths, 8 hundredths, 5 thousandths.

b.06762f94.bai_mau: Tiny has put every digit of 5.485 one column too far to the left, so the second row shows 54.85, not 5.485. The decimal points must line up: 5.485 is 5 ones, 4 tenths, 8 hundredths and 5 thousandths.

b.2e944d7b.de:
Alex subtracted 3.28 from 15.4 like this:
15.4 − 3.28 = 12.22 (Alex wrote: 8 − 0 = 8, 4 − 2 = 2, 15 − 3 = 12)
Explain the mistake Alex made and find the correct answer.

tu_kiem.t: Nêu đúng lỗi: Alex không viết placeholder zero (15.40) nên lấy 8 − 0 thay vì regroup rồi tính 10 − 8.
Có đáp số đúng 12.12.

b.2e944d7b.bai_mau: Alex forgot to write a placeholder zero in the hundredths column (15.40). As a result, Alex subtracted 0 from 8 instead of regrouping and subtracting 8 from 10. The correct answer is 15.40 − 3.28 = 12.12.

b.25be2b1c.nguon: LMS: Handbook to help explanations Q2
b.25be2b1c.de:
Emma bought a book for £6.45 and a pencil for £1.80. She paid with a £20 note.
Emma calculated her change: £20.00 − £6.45 = £13.55. She said her change is £13.55.
Explain the mistake Emma made in solving the word problem.

tu_kiem.t: Nêu đúng lỗi: Emma quên trừ tiền cái pencil (£1.80).
Nói cách đúng: tính total cost của hai món trước, rồi lấy £20 trừ đi.

b.25be2b1c.bai_mau: Emma forgot to subtract the cost of the pencil (£1.80). She only subtracted the book (£6.45) from £20.00. She must find the total cost of both items first: £6.45 + £1.80 = £8.25. Change = £20.00 − £8.25 = £11.75.

b.de86dc4e.de: A student solved 12.45 − 3.829 and got 9.631. What mistake did they make?

tu_kiem.t: Nêu đúng lỗi: bạn ấy exchange 1 sang cột bên phải nhưng không bớt 1 ở cột cho mượn (hundredths vẫn tính 5 − 2, ones vẫn tính 12 − 3).
Nêu cách làm đúng: 12.450 − 3.829 (placeholder zero), exchange xong thì bớt 1 ở cột cho mượn — hoặc estimate 12 − 4 = 8 để thấy 9.631 quá lớn.

b.de86dc4e.bai_mau: The student exchanged but did not take the 1 away from the column they exchanged from: in the hundredths they did 5 − 2 = 3 instead of 4 − 2 = 2, and in the ones they did 12 − 3 = 9 instead of 11 − 3 = 8. The correct answer is 12.450 − 3.829 = 8.621.

b.0eea6888.nguon: LB p.120 Think like a mathematician

tu_kiem.t: Nêu được: numerator của đáp số = tổng hai denominator.
Nêu được: denominator của đáp số = tích hai denominator.

Thử quy luật trên MỘT phép cộng cụ thể: nêu rõ phép cộng (vd 1/5 + 1/2) rồi chỉ ra numerator của đáp số = tổng hai denominator VÀ denominator của đáp số = tích hai denominator (chỉ ghi một phép cộng hai số như 5 + 2 = 7 thì chưa đạt).

b.0eea6888.bai_mau: For 1/a + 1/b, the numerator of the answer is a + b and the denominator is a × b. For example {1/7} + {1/4} = {11/28}: 7 + 4 = 11 and 7 × 4 = 28.

b.fae01f66.de:
Chata solved this calculation: {3/5} + {3/8} = {6/13}
What mistake has Chata made?

tu_kiem.t: Nêu đúng lỗi: Chata cộng cả numerator lẫn denominator.
Nói cách đúng: đổi về common denominator 40 rồi chỉ cộng numerator.

b.fae01f66.bai_mau: Chata added the numerators and added the denominators. You must change both fractions to a common denominator first: {3/5} + {3/8} = {24/40} + {15/40} = {39/40}.

b.0e0dcd98.de:
Mia tried to add two fractions: {1/4} + {2/5}.
Mia wrote: {1/4} + {2/5} = (1 + 2) / (4 + 5) = {3/9} = {1/3}.
Explain the mistake Mia made and calculate the correct answer.

tu_kiem.t: Nêu đúng lỗi: Mia cộng cả numerator lẫn denominator — câu phải nói CẢ HAI (chỉ nói Mia cộng denominator thì chưa đạt).
Nói cách đúng: đổi về common denominator 20 rồi chỉ cộng numerator.

b.0e0dcd98.bai_mau: Mia added the numerators together and also added the denominators together. You cannot add fractions with different denominators directly. Mia must first change both fractions to equivalent fractions with a common denominator of 20: {1/4} = {5/20} and {2/5} = {8/20}, so {5/20} + {8/20} = {13/20}.

b.31ec67ba.de: Leila says, ‘The number represented in the place value grid is the largest number that can be made with nine counters.’ Do you agree? Explain your reasoning. (Grid: 10s 5 counters · 1s 1 counter · 1/10 1 counter · 1/100 1 counter · 1/1000 1 counter)

tu_kiem.t: đọc lưới: số trong lưới là 51.111 (9 counter)
đưa một số lớn hơn 51.111 làm được bằng chín counter (vd cả chín ở cột tens = 90)
kết luận Leila chưa đúng

b.31ec67ba.bai_mau: I do not agree. The grid shows 51.111. If Leila put all nine counters in the tens column she would make 90, and 90 is bigger than 51.111.

b.453c45a0.de: Mr. Jon says “In the number 367.461 both the 6 digits are worth the same.” Is he correct? Explain why he is / isn’t.

tu_kiem.t: Kết luận: Mr. Jon không đúng vì hai digit 6 đứng ở hai place value khác nhau
Nêu place value của từng digit được hỏi: tens và hundredths
Nêu value của từng digit được hỏi: 60 và 0.06

b.453c45a0.bai_mau: Mr. Jon is not correct. The first 6 is in the tens place, so it is worth 60. The second 6 is in the hundredths place, so it is worth 0.06. They are in different places, so they are worth different amounts.

b.83c819b4.de: Ms. Colette reads the number 17.539 out loud. She says: “The number is seventeen point five-hundred and nine. The three is worth hundredths.” Is she correct? What mistake(s) has she made?

tu_kiem.t: Nêu lỗi chính: phần sau decimal point phải đọc từng digit, không đọc như một số nguyên
Viết lại cách đọc đúng: seventeen point five three nine
Nhận ra phần «the three is worth hundredths» là đúng

b.83c819b4.bai_mau: She is not correct. After the decimal point each digit is read on its own, so the number is “seventeen point five three nine”, not “point five-hundred and nine”. The three is worth 3 hundredths, so that part is correct.

b.ce883597.de:
Which of the following is the odd one out? Why?
a: 5.628
b: 5,628 thousandths
c: 56 tenths and 28 thousandths
d: 56 hundredths and 28 tenths

tu_kiem.t: Nêu ba dòng cùng giá trị: ba dòng còn lại cùng bằng 5.628, chỉ viết khác nhau
Nêu dòng lẻ khác giá trị: 56 hundredths and 28 tenths bằng 3.36

b.ce883597.bai_mau: 5.628, 5628 thousandths and 56 tenths and 28 thousandths are all the same number, 5.628, written in different ways. 56 hundredths and 28 tenths is 0.56 + 2.8 = 3.36, so it is the odd one out.

b.84f75b96.nguon: LMS Place Value – Reasoning and Problem Solving (slide 3)
b.84f75b96.de:
Jack has got some place value counters.
“Some of my counters have a value of 1,000,000, some have a value of 10,000 and some have a value of 1”
Jack picks four counters.
What different numbers greater than 1,000,000 could he make?

tu_kiem.t: Nêu ít nhất hai số khác nhau: mỗi số được tạo từ đúng bốn counter loại 1000000, 10000 hoặc 1
Điều kiện lớn hơn: mỗi số nêu ra lớn hơn 1000000 (có ít nhất một counter 1000000)

b.84f75b96.bai_mau: He could make 1,030,000 (one counter of 1,000,000 and three counters of 10,000), or 3,000,001 (three counters of 1,000,000 and one counter of 1), or 2,020,000 (two counters of 1,000,000 and two counters of 10,000). Each number is greater than 1,000,000 because it uses at least one counter of 1,000,000.

b.1e6115a6.de:
Find the odd one out. Explain your answer.
a: 1.234
b: 1234 thousandths
c: 12.34
d: 123.4 hundredths
e: 123 hundredths and 4 thousandths

tu_kiem.t: chọn số khác: 12.34
chứng minh: bốn số còn lại đều bằng 1.234

b.1e6115a6.bai_mau: 12.34 is the odd one out. The other four numbers are all equal to 1.234 but 12.34 is ten times bigger.

b.7ecac2d8.de: Explain why 0.123 is not the same as 0.1 + 0.2 + 0.3. Use the place value of each digit in your explanation.

tu_kiem.t: Nêu cách khai triển đúng: 0.123 là 1 tenth, 2 hundredths và 3 thousandths
Chỉ ra vì sao phép cộng sai: 0.2 và 0.3 đều là tenths nên tổng 0.1 + 0.2 + 0.3 là 0.6

b.7ecac2d8.bai_mau: 0.123 is 1 tenth, 2 hundredths and 3 thousandths, which is 0.1 + 0.02 + 0.003. In 0.1 + 0.2 + 0.3 the 2 and the 3 are both written as tenths, so they are worth 0.2 and 0.3, and the total is 0.6. The digits 2 and 3 are in different places in 0.123.

b.a3f2eb7c.de:
Conject: How many different ways can you regroup this number?
**782.493**
Now write as many different ways as you can.

tu_kiem.t: Viết ít nhất hai cách regroup: mỗi cách là một tổng các phần của 782.493
Kiểm lại phép cộng: mỗi tổng đã viết phải bằng 782.493

b.29070160.de: Ms. Colette says “5,807 divided by 1,000 is 5.87”. Is she correct? What mistake has she made?

tu_kiem.t: Nêu lỗi chính: cô ấy làm mất digit 0 ở hundredths
Nêu kết quả đúng: 5807 ÷ 1000 bằng 5.807

b.29070160.bai_mau: She is not correct. Dividing by 1000 moves every digit three places to the right, so 5,807 ÷ 1,000 = 5.807. Ms. Colette left out the 0 in the hundredths place and wrote 5.87.

b.72abe16a.de: Ingrid says, ‘I can multiply by 100 by adding two zeros.’ Explain why Ingrid is wrong.

tu_kiem.t: cách thêm hai zero: chỉ đúng với số nguyên (whole number)
đưa một ví dụ số decimal × 100 (vd 1.5 × 100 = 150, không phải 1.500)
cách đúng: mỗi digit dịch sang trái hai hàng

b.72abe16a.bai_mau: Adding two zeros only works for whole numbers. When you multiply by 100, every digit moves two places to the left. For example, 1.5 × 100 = 150, but adding two zeros would give 1.500, which is still 1.5.

b.1725352d.de:
Look at these number cards. Write the correct letter of the card next to the correct sentence.
A 6.1   B 61   C 610   D 0.61
Write your own sentence for the card that is left.

tu_kiem.t: Viết một câu đúng cho thẻ C (610): dùng phép × hoặc ÷ 10, 100, 1000 với một số khác
Câu đưa ra phải đúng về value (kiểm lại phép tính)

b.1725352d.bai_mau: 610 is one hundred times bigger than 6.1. (Also: 610 is ten times bigger than 61, or one thousand times bigger than 0.61.)

b.47231ddc.nguon: LMS Decimals – Reasoning and Problem Solving (slide 11)
b.47231ddc.de:
Tiny is multiplying numbers by 100.
“When you multiply by 100, you just add two zeros to the end of the number.”
Give an example of a calculation where Tiny’s method works.

tu_kiem.t: Ví dụ đúng: nhân một số nguyên với 100 mà cách của Tiny cho kết quả đúng
Kết quả: nêu đúng kết quả của ví dụ đã đưa

b.47231ddc.bai_mau: Tiny’s method works for whole numbers: 7 × 100 = 700, and adding two zeros to 7 gives 700.

b.3d4a1684.nguon: LMS Decimals – Reasoning and Problem Solving (slide 11)
b.3d4a1684.de:
Tiny is multiplying numbers by 100.
“When you multiply by 100, you just add two zeros to the end of the number.”
Give an example of a calculation where Tiny’s method does **not** work.

tu_kiem.t: Ví dụ sai: nhân một số decimal với 100 mà thêm hai số 0 cho kết quả sai
Kết quả: nêu đúng kết quả của ví dụ đó

b.3d4a1684.bai_mau: Tiny’s method does not work for decimals: 2.5 × 100 = 250, but adding two zeros to 2.5 gives 2.500, which is still 2.5.

b.5c7e30b4.nguon: LMS Decimals – Reasoning and Problem Solving (slide 11)
b.5c7e30b4.de:
Tiny is multiplying numbers by 100.
“When you multiply by 100, you just add two zeros to the end of the number.”
What is a better way to explain how to multiply by 100?

tu_kiem.t: Giải thích đúng: khi nhân 100, mỗi digit dịch hai place value sang trái
Phạm vi: cách giải thích đúng cho cả số nguyên lẫn decimal

b.5c7e30b4.bai_mau: When you multiply by 100, every digit moves two places to the left, so each digit becomes 100 times bigger. This works for whole numbers and for decimals: 2.5 × 100 = 250 because the 2 moves from ones to hundreds and the 5 moves from tenths to tens.

b.ca052928.nguon: LMS Decimals – Reasoning and Problem Solving (slide 13)
b.ca052928.de:
Tiny says “When you divide by 10, 100 or 1,000, you just remove the zeros.”
Explain your answer.

tu_kiem.t: Kết luận: không đồng ý
Đưa ví dụ phản bác: chia một số không có số 0 ở cuối cho 10, 100 hoặc 1000
Giải thích đúng: mỗi digit dịch sang phải theo place value

b.ca052928.bai_mau: I do not agree. 45 ÷ 10 = 4.5, and there are no zeros to remove. When you divide by 10, every digit moves one place to the right, so each digit becomes 10 times smaller. It only looks like removing a zero when the number ends in 0, for example 450 ÷ 10 = 45.

b.9eac3007.de: Tom says, “To multiply by 10, just put a zero on the end. So 2.5 times 10 is 2.50.” Is Tom correct? Explain.

tu_kiem.t: Kết luận: Tom không đúng
Nêu lý do: viết thêm digit 0 ở cuối phần decimal không đổi value (2.50 bằng 2.5)
Nêu cách đúng: khi × 10 mỗi digit dịch sang trái một place, nên 2.5 × 10 bằng 25

b.9eac3007.bai_mau: Tom is not correct. 2.50 has the same value as 2.5, so putting a zero on the end does not change the number. When you multiply by 10, every digit moves one place to the left, so 2.5 × 10 = 25.

b.bbcbc666.nguon: LMS Place Value – Reasoning and Problem Solving (slide 14)
b.bbcbc666.de:
“56,700 is greater than 201,000 because 5 is greater than 2.”
Explain the mistake that Tiny has made.

tu_kiem.t: Nêu lỗi chính: Tiny chỉ so hai digit đầu mà không xét số digit và place value của mỗi số
Nêu cách so sánh đúng: 201000 có 6 digit, 56700 chỉ có 5 digit, nên 201000 lớn hơn

b.bbcbc666.bai_mau: Tiny only compared the first digits. 56,700 has 5 digits and its first digit is in the ten-thousands place, but 201,000 has 6 digits and its first digit is in the hundred-thousands place. So 201,000 is greater than 56,700.

b.1e5a6199.nguon: LMS Decimals – Reasoning and Problem Solving (slide 1)
b.1e5a6199.de:
Tiny says “The more decimal places a number has, the smaller the number is.”
Explain your answer.

tu_kiem.t: Kết luận: không đồng ý — số có nhiều decimal places hơn chưa chắc nhỏ hơn
Đưa ví dụ cụ thể: hai số, một số ít decimal places và một số nhiều decimal places, so sánh theo place value

b.1e5a6199.bai_mau: I do not agree. The number of decimal places does not tell you the size. 0.5 has one decimal place and 0.123 has three, but 0.5 = 0.500, which has 5 tenths, and 0.123 has only 1 tenth, so 0.5 is greater.

b.ac2f8a3a.nguon: LMS Decimals – Reasoning and Problem Solving (slide 6)
b.ac2f8a3a.de:
Is the statement always true, sometimes true or never true?
“A number with 3 decimal places is greater than a number with only 1 decimal place.”
a: Always true
b: Sometimes true
c: Never true
Explain your answer.

tu_kiem.t: Kết luận: đôi khi đúng
Đưa hai ví dụ: một cặp số làm câu đúng và một cặp làm câu sai

b.ac2f8a3a.bai_mau: It is sometimes true. 5.123 has 3 decimal places and is greater than 0.5, which has 1 decimal place. But 0.123 has 3 decimal places and is smaller than 0.5. So the number of decimal places alone does not decide which number is greater.

b.1f3068f0.de: Stefan says, ‘When I round 16.51 and 17.49 to the nearest whole number, the answer is the same. When I round 16.51 and 17.49 to the nearest tenth, the difference between the answers is one.’ Explain why Stefan is correct.

tu_kiem.t: nearest whole number: cả hai số đều round về 17
nearest tenth: hai kết quả là 16.5 và 17.5
kết luận: hiệu 17.5 − 16.5 = 1 nên Stefan đúng

b.1f3068f0.bai_mau: To the nearest whole number, 16.51 rounds to 17 and 17.49 rounds to 17, so the answers are the same. To the nearest tenth, 16.51 rounds to 16.5 and 17.49 rounds to 17.5. The difference between 17.5 and 16.5 is 1, so Stefan is correct.

b.08708ddb.de: Jasper says, ‘7.97 is 8 when rounded to the nearest whole number and is also 8 when rounded to the nearest tenth.’ Is Jasper correct? Explain your answer.

tu_kiem.t: nearest whole number: 7.97 round về 8
nearest tenth: 7.97 round về 8.0 (phải có 1 decimal place)
kết luận: Jasper chưa đúng

b.08708ddb.bai_mau: Jasper is not correct. 7.97 is 8 to the nearest whole number, but to the nearest tenth it is 8.0, because the answer keeps one decimal place.

b.26f982ba.de:
Mr. Jon thinks of a number.
- It is greater than 45.
- Has an even number in the tenths and hundredths.
- Rounds to 60 when rounding to the nearest 10.
What could his number be?

tu_kiem.t: Điều kiện về độ lớn và digit: số lớn hơn 45, tenths và hundredths đều là digit chẵn
Điều kiện round: tới nearest 10 ra 60, nên số nằm từ 55 tới dưới 65

b.26f982ba.bai_mau: It could be 58.24. It is greater than 45, the tenths digit 2 and the hundredths digit 4 are both even, and 58.24 rounds to 60 to the nearest 10.

b.d1aade4d.de: Write an explanation of how to round decimals to the nearest tenth.

tu_kiem.t: Nêu bước nhìn digit ở hundredths để quyết định round up hay giữ nguyên
Nêu quy tắc đúng: hundredths từ 5 tới 9 thì tenths tăng 1, từ 0 tới 4 thì tenths giữ nguyên
Có ví dụ cụ thể: một số có 2 decimal places

b.d1aade4d.bai_mau: To round to the nearest tenth, look at the hundredths digit. If it is 5, 6, 7, 8 or 9, the tenths digit goes up by 1. If it is 0, 1, 2, 3 or 4, the tenths digit stays the same. For example, 5.67 rounds to 5.7 because the hundredths digit is 7, and 5.44 rounds to 5.4 because the hundredths digit is 4.

b.76293799.nguon: LMS Nearest Whole Number writing Q3
b.76293799.de: Write a question involving rounding a decimal number to a whole number. Show an incorrect answer and explain the mistake.

tu_kiem.t: Viết một câu hỏi round một số decimal tới nearest whole number
Nêu một đáp số sai cho câu hỏi đó
Giải thích đúng lỗi dẫn tới đáp số sai (ví dụ nhìn nhầm digit hoặc round down khi phải lên)

b.76293799.bai_mau: Question: Round 6.58 to the nearest whole number. Incorrect answer: 6. The mistake: the tenths digit is 5, and 5 means round up, but this answer rounded down. The correct answer is 7.

b.67d01561.de: Lan rounds 14.47 to the nearest whole number. She writes, “14.47 rounds to 14.5, and 14.5 rounds to 15, so the answer is 15.” Is Lan correct? Explain.

tu_kiem.t: Kết luận: Lan không đúng
Nêu lý do: chỉ nhìn digit ở tenths của số ban đầu (4 nhỏ hơn 5), không round hai lần
Nêu đáp số đúng: 14.47 round tới nearest whole number là 14

b.67d01561.bai_mau: Lan is not correct. To round to the nearest whole number you only look at the tenths digit of 14.47. It is 4, which is less than 5, so 14.47 rounds down to 14. Rounding twice made the number go up to 15 by mistake.

b.bc999bc4.de:
The numbers in this sequence increase by equal amounts each time.
a: multiply by 8
b: add 8
c: add 32
d: multiply by 32
Explain your answer.

tu_kiem.t: thử rule bằng một term: multiply by 8 cho term đầu là 1 × 8 = 8, không phải 10 (hoặc: 10 không phải multiple of 8)
kết luận: Salma không đúng

b.bc999bc4.bai_mau: Salma is not correct. If the position-to-term rule were multiply by 8, the 1st term would be 1 × 8 = 8, but the 1st term is 10. The terms are not multiples of 8. Add 8 is the term-to-term rule, not the position-to-term rule.

b.aff813fb.de: Ollie writes a number sequence starting at 15 and counting back in steps of 0.4. 15, 14.6, 14.2, 13.8, … He says, ‘1.5 cannot be in my sequence.’ Ollie is correct. How do you know without counting back?

tu_kiem.t: lý do không cần count back: nêu một điều MỌI term đều có mà 1.5 không có (vd tenths digit của mọi term là số chẵn, còn 1.5 có tenths là 5, số lẻ; hoặc 15 − 1.5 = 13.5 không chia đều thành các step 0.4)
kết luận: 1.5 không thể có trong sequence

b.aff813fb.bai_mau: Every number in Ollie’s sequence has an even tenths digit: 15.0, 14.6, 14.2, 13.8, 13.4, 13.0, … because counting back 0.4 always takes away 4 tenths. 1.5 has 5 tenths, and 5 is odd, so 1.5 cannot be in the sequence.

b.092fe678.nguon: LB p.26 Think like a mathematician
b.092fe678.de:
The diagram shows the first five hexagonal numbers: 1, 6, 15, 28, 45 ….
Write these numbers as the sum of two hexagonal numbers: 12, 21, 39, 30. The first one is done for you: 12 = 6 + 6.

tu_kiem.t: 12, 21, 30: viết đúng mỗi số thành tổng của hai hexagonal number (vd 21 = 6 + 15)
39: nhận ra 39 KHÔNG viết được thành tổng của hai hexagonal number (thử 39 − 1, 39 − 6, 39 − 15, 39 − 28 đều không ra hexagonal number)

b.092fe678.bai_mau: 12 = 6 + 6, 21 = 6 + 15 and 30 = 15 + 15. 39 cannot be written as the sum of two hexagonal numbers: 39 − 1 = 38, 39 − 6 = 33, 39 − 15 = 24 and 39 − 28 = 11, and none of these is a hexagonal number.

b.21b7c87d.nguon: LB p.26 Think like a mathematician
b.21b7c87d.de:
The diagram shows the first five hexagonal numbers: 1, 6, 15, 28, 45 ….
Investigate which other numbers, less than 100, can be written as the sum of two hexagonal numbers.

tu_kiem.t: ví dụ: nêu ít nhất ba số khác, mỗi số nhỏ hơn 100, viết đúng thành tổng của hai hexagonal number
chỉ dùng hexagonal number của sequence (1, 6, 15, 28, 45 và số tiếp theo)

b.de6c10d3.de:
Tommy and Whitney are counting.
Tommy says: 3, 2, 1, −1, −2, −3. What mistake has Tommy made?

tu_kiem.t: lỗi của Tommy: bỏ qua số 0 khi count back từ 1 xuống −1
sửa lại: count back đúng là 3, 2, 1, 0, −1, −2

b.de6c10d3.bai_mau: Tommy has missed out 0. After 1 he should say 0, then −1. The correct count is 3, 2, 1, 0, −1, −2.

b.3ece80a0.de:
Tommy and Whitney are counting.
Whitney says: 3, 2, 1, 0, −3, −2, −1. What mistake has Whitney made?

tu_kiem.t: lỗi của Whitney: sau 0 viết −3, −2, −1 theo thứ tự sai (count back thì sau 0 là −1, rồi −2, −3)
sửa lại: count back đúng là 3, 2, 1, 0, −1, −2, −3

b.3ece80a0.bai_mau: Whitney has put the negative numbers in the wrong order. When you count back, the number after 0 is −1, then −2, then −3. The correct count is 3, 2, 1, 0, −1, −2, −3.

b.5da3215f.de:
The surface of a lake is at 0 m.
A fish is swimming at −3 m.
The fish swims down another 4 m away from the surface of the water.
Tiny: “The fish is now swimming at 1 m.”
How do you know that Tiny must be incorrect?

tu_kiem.t: hướng bơi: cá bơi XUỐNG thêm, xa mặt nước hơn, nên phải ở sâu hơn −3 m
so với mặt nước: 1 m ở TRÊN mặt nước (lớn hơn 0 m), nên Tiny sai

b.5da3215f.bai_mau: The fish starts below the surface at −3 m and swims further down, so it must be deeper than −3 m. 1 m is above the surface of the water, so Tiny must be incorrect. Tiny worked out −3 + 4 instead of −3 − 4.

b.9da3240d.de:
A sequence has the position-to-term rule multiply by 4.
Explain how you know.

tu_kiem.t: dùng position-to-term rule: mọi term là position × 4, tức là multiple of 4
lý do về số đang xét: 50 không phải multiple of 4 (50 ÷ 4 không ra số nguyên, hoặc 50 nằm giữa hai term 48 và 52)

b.9da3240d.bai_mau: The position-to-term rule is multiply by 4, so every term is a multiple of 4. 50 is not a multiple of 4: 12 × 4 = 48 and 13 × 4 = 52, so 50 is between two terms. 50 is not in the sequence.

b.f719ab57.de:
Vincent makes a sequence using patterns of rectangular bricks. (The pictures show shape 1 made of 1 brick, shape 2 made of 4 bricks and shape 3 made of 9 bricks.)
How do you know?

tu_kiem.t: quy luật: số viên gạch của mỗi shape là square number (shape n có n × n viên)
áp dụng cho shape đang hỏi: 10 × 10 (10²)

b.f719ab57.bai_mau: The numbers of bricks are square numbers: shape 1 has 1 × 1 brick, shape 2 has 2 × 2 bricks and shape 3 has 3 × 3 bricks. So shape 10 has 10 × 10 = 100 bricks, which is 10².

b.95ad564c.de: Emma uses small cubes to make a larger cube. She uses 16 cubes to make the base of her cube. How many small cubes does Emma use to make the larger cube? How do you know?

tu_kiem.t: đáy: 16 = 4 × 4 nên mỗi cạnh dài 4 cube nhỏ
cả khối: 4 tầng, mỗi tầng 16 cube nhỏ, nên 16 × 4 (hay 4³)

b.95ad564c.bai_mau: The base is a square of 16 cubes, and 16 = 4 × 4, so each edge is 4 cubes long. A cube is as tall as it is long, so there are 4 layers of 16 cubes: 16 × 4 = 64. This is 4³.

b.bd660ef3.de: Classify these expressions into two groups. Explain how you chose the groups. 2³ · 3² · 2³ + 1 · half of 4² · 3² − 1

tu_kiem.t: hai nhóm: mỗi biểu thức nằm trong đúng một nhóm
lý do: nêu điều chung của mỗi nhóm (ví dụ cùng giá trị) và điều đó đúng với mọi biểu thức trong nhóm

b.bd660ef3.bai_mau: Group 1: 2³, half of 4² and 3² − 1. They are all equal to 8. Group 2: 3² and 2³ + 1. They are both equal to 9. I worked out the value of each expression and put the expressions with the same value together.

b.4998f515.nguon: LB p.29 Think like a mathematician
b.4998f515.de: Two consecutive squares. 1 and 4 are two consecutive square numbers. 1 + 4 = 5. 4 and 9 are two consecutive square numbers. 4 + 9 = 13. Investigate the sums of two consecutive square numbers. If you are systematic you should find an interesting pattern. Adding odd numbers. The first two odd numbers are 1 and 3. Their sum is 4. The first five odd numbers are 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9. What is their sum? Investigate the sums of consecutive odd numbers starting at 1. What do you notice?

tu_kiem.t: các tổng: tính đúng ít nhất bốn tổng của hai square number liên tiếp (1 + 4, 4 + 9, 9 + 16, 16 + 25, …)
quy luật: nêu một quy luật đúng của các tổng (ví dụ tổng luôn là odd number, hay hiệu giữa hai tổng liền nhau tăng thêm 4 mỗi lần)

b.4998f515.bai_mau: 1 + 4 = 5, 4 + 9 = 13, 9 + 16 = 25, 16 + 25 = 41, 25 + 36 = 61 and 36 + 49 = 85. The sums are 5, 13, 25, 41, 61, 85. They are all odd numbers. The differences between them are 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, so the difference goes up by 4 each time.

b.70c70a8a.nguon: LB p.29 Think like a mathematician
b.70c70a8a.de: Two consecutive squares. 1 and 4 are two consecutive square numbers. 1 + 4 = 5. 4 and 9 are two consecutive square numbers. 4 + 9 = 13. Investigate the sums of two consecutive square numbers. If you are systematic you should find an interesting pattern. Adding odd numbers. The first two odd numbers are 1 and 3. Their sum is 4. The first five odd numbers are 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9. What is their sum? Investigate the sums of consecutive odd numbers starting at 1. What do you notice?

tu_kiem.t: các tổng: tính đúng vài tổng bắt đầu từ 1 (1, 1 + 3, 1 + 3 + 5, …)
nhận xét: các tổng đều là square number

b.70c70a8a.bai_mau: 1 = 1, 1 + 3 = 4, 1 + 3 + 5 = 9, 1 + 3 + 5 + 7 = 16 and 1 + 3 + 5 + 7 + 9 = 25. The sums are 1, 4, 9, 16, 25: they are the square numbers. If you add the first n odd numbers, you get n × n.

b.e39473d0.de: There is only one 2-digit number that is both a square and a cube number! Can you find it? How could you organise your working?

tu_kiem.t: danh sách square number: liệt kê các square number có hai chữ số
danh sách cube number: liệt kê các cube number có hai chữ số
so hai danh sách: tìm số có mặt ở cả hai danh sách

b.e39473d0.bai_mau: I would make two lists. The 2-digit square numbers are 16, 25, 36, 49, 64 and 81. The 2-digit cube numbers are 27 and 64. Then I look for the number that is in both lists: 64.

b.5dae9261.de:
Ben says, ‘8² = 16, because 8 × 2 = 16.’ Is Ben correct? Explain.
Explain Ben’s mistake.

tu_kiem.t: kết luận: Ben chưa đúng
lý do: 8² là 8 nhân với chính nó (8 × 8), không phải 8 × 2

b.5dae9261.bai_mau: Ben is not correct. 8² means 8 multiplied by itself, so it is 8 × 8, not 8 × 2. Ben multiplied by 2 instead. 8 × 8 = 64, so 8² = 64.

b.abf3efd9.de: Write these numbers in the correct place on the Venn diagram. 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7. (The Venn diagram has two overlapping circles: ‘factors of 20’ and ‘factors of 24’. The overlap is shaded.) What is special about the numbers in the shaded area?

tu_kiem.t: dùng đúng thuật ngữ: các số trong vùng tô là common factors của 20 và 24
giải thích: mỗi số trong vùng tô là factor của cả 20 lẫn 24

b.abf3efd9.bai_mau: The numbers in the shaded area are the common factors of 20 and 24. Each of them is a factor of 20 and also a factor of 24.

b.dc4b29f2.de: Write these numbers in the correct place on the Venn diagram. 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9. (The Venn diagram has two overlapping circles: ‘factors of 30’ and ‘factors of 24’. The overlap is shaded.) What is special about the numbers in the shaded area?

tu_kiem.t: dùng đúng thuật ngữ: các số trong vùng tô là common factors của 30 và 24
giải thích: mỗi số trong vùng tô là factor của cả 30 lẫn 24

b.dc4b29f2.bai_mau: The numbers in the shaded area are the common factors of 30 and 24. Each of them is a factor of 30 and also a factor of 24.

b.99cd4e94.de:
Omar packs boxes of mangoes and boxes of peaches. Each box contains the same number of fruits. Omar packs 56 mangoes and 49 peaches. Ahmed says, ‘There will be 8 pieces of fruit in each box.’ Hassan says, ‘There will be 7 pieces of fruit in each box.’ Who is correct? Explain your answer.
a: Ahmed
b: Hassan

tu_kiem.t: kết luận: Hassan đúng, Ahmed sai
lý do Hassan đúng: 7 là common factor của 56 và 49
lý do Ahmed sai: 8 không phải factor của 49

b.99cd4e94.bai_mau: Hassan is correct. 7 is a common factor of 56 and 49, so the mangoes fill 8 boxes of 7 and the peaches fill 7 boxes of 7. Ahmed is wrong, because 8 is not a factor of 49.

b.f2bc8ae4.de: Pierre gives 32 football cards to his friends. He shares them equally so all his friends have the same amount. How many friends could Pierre have? Explain your answer.

tu_kiem.t: điều kiện: số bạn phải là factor của 32
giải thích bằng phép chia: 32 chia cho số bạn không còn thẻ thừa

b.f2bc8ae4.bai_mau: Pierre could have 2, 4, 8, 16 or 32 friends. The number of friends must be a factor of 32, because the 32 cards are shared equally with none left over. For example, with 4 friends each friend gets 32 ÷ 4 = 8 cards.

b.9d9814b6.nguon: LB p.33 Think like a mathematician
b.9d9814b6.de: The sequence 4, 2, 1, 3 uses the numbers 1 to 4 so that each number is either a factor or a multiple of the previous number. Each number is used once only. Find a similar sequence that uses the numbers 1 to 6.

tu_kiem.t: dùng đủ sáu số: mỗi số từ 1 đến 6 có mặt đúng một lần
từng cặp liền nhau: số sau là factor hoặc multiple của số trước

b.9d9814b6.bai_mau: 5, 1, 3, 6, 2, 4. 1 is a factor of 5, 3 is a multiple of 1, 6 is a multiple of 3, 2 is a factor of 6 and 4 is a multiple of 2. Each number from 1 to 6 is used once.

b.6402cf5e.de:
Look at the common multiples of 4 and 5 from part b).
What do you notice?
Describe how to find more common multiples to add to this list.
Would you ever run out of common multiples?
What do you notice? Describe how to find more common multiples to add to this list. Would you ever run out of common multiples?

tu_kiem.t: nhận xét: các common multiple đều là multiple của 20 (cách nhau đều 20)
cách tìm thêm: cộng thêm 20 vào số cuối, hoặc nhân 20 với 4, 5, 6 …
kết luận: không bao giờ hết common multiple

b.6402cf5e.bai_mau: The common multiples 20, 40 and 60 are all multiples of 20, the lowest common multiple of 4 and 5. To find more, keep adding 20: 80, 100, 120 … You would never run out, because the multiples of 20 go on for ever.

b.7c1fc576.de:
Alex is making party bags.
She has 35 sweets and 25 balloons.
All the sweets and balloons need to be shared equally, so that each bag has the same number of sweets and balloons.
Alex: “I can put 5 sweets and 5 balloons in each bag because 5 is a common factor of 35 and 25.”
Is Alex correct?
Explain your answer.

tu_kiem.t: kết luận: Alex chưa đúng
chỉ ra số túi không khớp: sweets cần 7 túi, balloons chỉ đủ 5 túi
cách đúng: common factor 5 là số túi (mỗi túi 7 sweets và 5 balloons)

b.7c1fc576.bai_mau: Alex is not correct. With 5 sweets in each bag, the 35 sweets fill 7 bags, but with 5 balloons in each bag, the 25 balloons fill only 5 bags. 5 is a common factor of 35 and 25, but it is the number of bags: 5 bags, each with 7 sweets and 5 balloons.

b.1017e20a.de:
Maya says, ‘The lowest common multiple of 6 and 8 is 48, because 6 × 8 = 48.’
Explain Maya’s mistake.

tu_kiem.t: chỉ ra common multiple nhỏ hơn: 24 là multiple của cả 6 và 8 và nhỏ hơn 48
nhận xét cách nhân: 6 × 8 cho một common multiple nhưng không phải lúc nào cũng là lowest

b.1017e20a.bai_mau: Maya is not correct. 48 is a common multiple of 6 and 8, but it is not the lowest one. 24 is a multiple of 6 and a multiple of 8, and 24 is smaller than 48. Multiplying two numbers always gives a common multiple, but not always the lowest common multiple.

b.774c3a38.de:
Ravi completes a subtraction calculation, but his answer is wrong. 36,804 − 5,724 = 31,180
Write an explanation to convince Ravi that he is wrong.

tu_kiem.t: Dùng một cách kiểm đúng: inverse (cộng 31180 + 5724) hoặc làm lại phép trừ cột có exchange
Cho thấy Ravi sai, một trong hai là đủ: kiểm bằng inverse ra số khác 36804 (vd 31180 + 5724 = 36904, không phải 36804), HOẶC chỉ ra hàng bị quên exchange (hàng tens cần exchange từ hàng hundreds)

b.774c3a38.bai_mau: Ravi is wrong. Check with the inverse: 31,180 + 5,724 = 36,904, but the number he started with is 36,804. The two numbers are different, so the subtraction must contain a mistake. In the tens column an exchange is needed, and Ravi probably forgot it.

b.47f2e0e0.nguon: LB p.53 Think like a mathematician
b.47f2e0e0.de:
Choose three digits. Arrange them in order, biggest first. Reverse the digits. Find the difference between the two numbers. Reverse the answer. Add the two numbers. Do this several times.
What do you notice?

tu_kiem.t: Nêu điều nhận thấy: với ba digit luôn ra cùng một số (1089)
Có ít nhất một ví dụ ba digit làm đúng đủ các bước (vd 852 − 258 = 594; 594 + 495 = 1089)

b.47f2e0e0.bai_mau: I always get 1089. With 2, 5 and 8: 852 − 258 = 594, then 594 reversed is 495 and 594 + 495 = 1089. With 9, 4 and 1: 941 − 149 = 792, then 792 + 297 = 1089 again.

b.6c848445.nguon: LB p.53 Think like a mathematician
b.6c848445.de:
Choose three digits. Arrange them in order, biggest first. Reverse the digits. Find the difference between the two numbers. Reverse the answer. Add the two numbers. Do this several times.
Start with four digits. What do you notice?

tu_kiem.t: Có ít nhất một ví dụ bốn digit làm đúng đủ các bước (vd 4321 − 1234 = 3087; 3087 + 7803 = 10890)
Nêu điều nhận thấy khớp với các ví dụ của con (vd luôn ra 10890, hoặc ra 10890 / 10989 — không còn là 1089)

b.6c848445.bai_mau: With 4, 3, 2 and 1: 4,321 − 1,234 = 3,087, then 3,087 + 7,803 = 10,890. With 4, 3, 3 and 1: 4,331 − 1,334 = 2,997, then 2,997 + 7,992 = 10,989. So with four digits the answer is not always the same number, but it is always 10,890 or 10,989.

b.13bb7908.nguon: LB p.53 Think like a mathematician
b.13bb7908.de:
Choose three digits. Arrange them in order, biggest first. Reverse the digits. Find the difference between the two numbers. Reverse the answer. Add the two numbers. Do this several times.
Predict what the answer will be if you start with two digits. Test your prediction. Was your prediction correct?

tu_kiem.t: Nêu dự đoán trước khi thử
Có ít nhất một ví dụ hai digit làm đúng đủ các bước (vd 83 − 38 = 45; 45 + 54 = 99)
Kết luận: với hai digit luôn ra 99, và nói dự đoán đúng hay sai

b.13bb7908.bai_mau: I predicted that the answer would always be the same number. Test: 83 − 38 = 45, then 45 + 54 = 99. Another test: 52 − 25 = 27, then 27 + 72 = 99. With two digits the answer is always 99, so my prediction was correct.

b.e1e902c2.de:
Meera says, ‘I can work out 79,999 − 19,999 in my head.’
Explain how Meera could do the calculation mentally.

tu_kiem.t: Nêu cách tính nhẩm: cộng 1 vào cả hai số (79999 thành 80000, 19999 thành 20000), hoặc thấy bốn hàng cuối trừ ra 0 rồi chỉ còn trừ hàng ten thousands
Giải thích vì sao cách đó đúng: cộng cùng một số vào cả hai số thì difference không đổi (hoặc mỗi hàng 9 − 9 = 0)

b.e1e902c2.bai_mau: Meera can add 1 to both numbers: 79,999 becomes 80,000 and 19,999 becomes 20,000. Adding the same amount to both numbers does not change the difference, so she only has to subtract 2 ten thousands from 8 ten thousands.

b.86f16855.de:
Check your understanding.
Add together this list of numbers.
6,732 · 4,939 · 3,205 · 1,053 · 5,555 · 6,732 · 9,824 · 7,832
Make sure you: 1. Estimate 2. Calculate 3. Check
Ms. Anh says estimating and checking are a waste of time.
Write an explanation that convinces her that they are important and useful.

tu_kiem.t: Nêu ích lợi của estimate: biết trước đáp số khoảng bao nhiêu, nên thấy ngay đáp số vô lý
Nêu ích lợi của check: tìm ra lỗi nhỏ khi tính (vd quên nhớ), bằng cách cộng lại theo thứ tự khác hoặc dùng inverse

b.86f16855.bai_mau: Estimating is useful because it tells me roughly what the answer should be. Rounding each number to the nearest thousand gives 7,000 + 5,000 + 3,000 + 1,000 + 6,000 + 7,000 + 10,000 + 8,000, which is about 47,000. If my answer was about 4,000 or 400,000, I would know at once that I made a mistake. Checking, for example adding the numbers again in a different order, finds small mistakes like forgetting to carry, which an estimate cannot show.

b.d87e8c7a.de:
Mr. Jon says, “The difference between the numbers −10 and −15 is −5”.
Explain your answer.

tu_kiem.t: Kết luận: Mr. Jon chưa đúng
Giải thích: difference là khoảng cách giữa hai số trên number line nên không bao giờ âm
Nêu difference đúng: 5 (đếm từ −15 lên −10)

b.d87e8c7a.bai_mau: Mr. Jon is not correct. The difference between two numbers is the distance between them on a number line, so it cannot be negative. From −15 up to −10 is 5 steps, so the difference is 5, not −5.

b.111fabf0.de:
Below is a table showing some estimates of the number of different wild elephants. The table has two columns: the type of elephant and its estimated wild population.
African Bush Elephant: 400,000 to 450,000
African Forest Elephant: 100,000
Asian Elephant: 40,000 to 50,000
Borneo Elephant: 1,500
Mr. David says, “The estimated total population of wild elephants is 541,500.” Mr. John says, “The estimated total population of wild elephants is 601,500.” Explain why they could both be correct.

tu_kiem.t: Estimate trong bảng là một khoảng: vd 400000 – 450000, không phải một số
Chỉ ra Mr. David cộng số nhỏ nhất của mỗi khoảng (400000 + 100000 + 40000 + 1500)
Chỉ ra Mr. John cộng số lớn nhất của mỗi khoảng (450000 + 100000 + 50000 + 1500)

b.111fabf0.bai_mau: Two of the estimates are ranges, not single numbers. Mr. David used the smallest number of each range: 400,000 + 100,000 + 40,000 + 1,500 = 541,500. Mr. John used the largest number of each range: 450,000 + 100,000 + 50,000 + 1,500 = 601,500. Both totals fit the table, so they could both be correct.

b.e0adbca5.nguon: LMS: Addition and Subtraction Problems challenge cards (card 2)
b.e0adbca5.de:
Over the weekend, Nikita spends 85 minutes on her project and 45 minutes on her maths homework.
On Monday, she spends 65 minutes on her spelling and grammar homework.
Explain how you would work out how much longer she spends on her homework over the weekend. Can you find more than one method?

tu_kiem.t: Nêu một cách đúng: cộng thời gian hai việc cuối tuần rồi trừ thời gian thứ Hai
Nêu cách thứ hai khác cách thứ nhất (vd lấy 85 − 65 trước rồi cộng 45)

b.e0adbca5.bai_mau: Method 1: add the weekend times, 85 + 45, then take away the 65 minutes of Monday. Method 2: first take Monday's time from the project time, 85 − 65 = 20, then add the 45 minutes of maths homework.

b.00e6429b.de:
Mia says, ‘5 − (−3) = 2, because 5 − 3 = 2.’
Explain your answer.

tu_kiem.t: Kết luận: Mia chưa đúng
Giải thích: trừ một số âm giống như cộng (5 − (−3) = 5 + 3), hoặc trên number line trừ số âm thì đi sang phải
Nêu đáp số đúng: 8

b.00e6429b.bai_mau: Mia is not correct. Subtracting a negative number is the same as adding, so 5 − (−3) = 5 + 3 = 8. On a number line, subtracting −3 moves 3 to the right from 5, so the answer is 8, not 2.

b.2b431d83.de:
Khalid says, ‘x + 3 is the same as 3 + x so x − 3 must be the same as 3 − x.’
Explain your answer.

tu_kiem.t: Kết luận: Khalid không đúng, x − 3 và 3 − x không bằng nhau

Lý do: nêu luật (phép cộng đổi chỗ hai số vẫn cùng kết quả, phép trừ đổi chỗ thì kết quả khác) HOẶC đưa ví dụ bằng số cho thấy x − 3 và 3 − x ra hai kết quả khác nhau (vd x = 5: 2 và −2); một trong hai là đủ

b.2b431d83.bai_mau: Khalid is not correct. You can add in any order, so x + 3 is the same as 3 + x. You cannot subtract in any order. For example, if x = 5, then x − 3 is 5 − 3 = 2 but 3 − x is 3 − 5 = −2, which is different.

b.fc37e761.nguon: LB p.59 Think like a mathematician
b.fc37e761.de:
a, b and c each represent a whole number from 1 upwards. a + b + c = 7
How many different solutions can you find?

tu_kiem.t: Số solution: nêu số bộ (a, b, c) đếm được và nói rõ cách đếm (đổi thứ tự là bộ khác: 15; coi đổi thứ tự là một: 4)
Đúng điều kiện: mọi bộ nêu ra có a + b + c = 7 và mỗi số từ 1 trở lên

b.fc37e761.bai_mau: There are 15 different solutions when the order matters. With a = 1 there are 5 (1, 1, 5 · 1, 2, 4 · 1, 3, 3 · 1, 4, 2 · 1, 5, 1), with a = 2 there are 4, with a = 3 there are 3, with a = 4 there are 2 and with a = 5 there is 1. 5 + 4 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 15. I went through the values of a in order so that I did not miss any.

b.d62d5871.de: a  If □ = 7 and ○ = 5 what is the value of □ + ○ + ○? b  If a = 7 and y = 5 what is the value of a + b + b? c  What is the same and what is different about these two questions?

tu_kiem.t: Điểm giống: hai câu là cùng một phép tính và cùng đáp số
Điểm khác: câu a dùng hình (□, ○), câu b dùng letter (a, b) để đại diện cho số

b.d62d5871.bai_mau: They are the same question: in both we work out 7 + 5 + 5 and get 17. The difference is how the numbers are shown: question a uses shapes (□ and ○) and question b uses letters (a and b).

b.e5ed5053.de:
Retrieval Practice – Last Lesson
Mr. Rhys says: “6 − y is the same as y − 6”.
Explain your answer.

tu_kiem.t: Kết luận: Mr. Rhys không đúng
Lý do: nêu luật (đổi chỗ hai số trong phép trừ thì kết quả thay đổi) HOẶC đưa ví dụ bằng số: thay một value cho y, tính cả 6 − y lẫn y − 6 và thấy hai kết quả khác nhau; một trong hai là đủ

b.e5ed5053.bai_mau: Mr. Rhys is not correct. In subtraction the order matters. For example, if y = 1, then 6 − y is 6 − 1 = 5 but y − 6 is 1 − 6 = −5, so they are not the same.

b.75bc1098.de: Write an expression that has a variable and an operator.

tu_kiem.t: Có variable: expression có một letter đại diện cho một số
Có operator: expression có một dấu phép tính (+, −, × hoặc ÷)
Là expression: không có dấu = (vd x + 3, không phải x + 3 = 5)

b.75bc1098.bai_mau: n + 7 is an expression. The letter n is the variable, because it can stand for any number, and + is the operator.

b.25f5faa0.de:
Here is an equation.
● + ■ = 12
(● is a circle and ■ is a square.)
What is the same and what is different about part a) and part b)?

tu_kiem.t: Điểm giống: cùng một equation, hai số cộng lại bằng 12, nên cùng các cặp value dùng được cho cả hai
Điểm khác: phần a dùng hình (● và ■), phần b dùng letter (x và y)

b.25f5faa0.bai_mau: Both parts are the same equation: two numbers that add to 12, so the same pairs work in both, for example 5 and 7. The difference is that part a uses shapes (a circle and a square) and part b uses letters (x and y).

b.b94f1d72.de:
Kim buys these two items from a cafe (a cookie and a cup of coffee).
The total cost is 90p.
Explain your answer.

tu_kiem.t: Kết luận: không thể, cà phê không thể giá 90p
Lý do: nếu cà phê giá 90p thì món còn lại giá 0p, mà món nào cũng phải có giá

b.b94f1d72.bai_mau: It is not possible. The two items cost 90p altogether. If the coffee cost 90p, the cookie would cost 0p, but the cookie must cost something.

b.0852fbb5.de:
a and b are whole numbers.
a + b = 8
Complete the table to show different possible values for a and b.
What patterns do you notice?

tu_kiem.t: Nêu một quy luật đúng: a tăng 1 thì b giảm 1, HOẶC tổng a + b luôn bằng 8; một trong hai là đủ

b.0852fbb5.bai_mau: When a goes up by 1, b goes down by 1. The total a + b is always 8.

b.16426d0e.de:
Mo: “It does not matter what p and q are, p + q and q + p will always give the same answer.”
Explain your answer.

tu_kiem.t: Kết luận: đồng ý với Mo
Lý do: nêu luật (cộng hai số theo thứ tự nào cũng ra cùng tổng, với mọi value của p và q) HOẶC đưa ví dụ bằng số: thay value cho p và q, tính p + q và q + p ra cùng một số; một trong hai là đủ

b.16426d0e.bai_mau: I agree with Mo. When you add two numbers, the order does not change the total. For example, if p = 3 and q = 8, then p + q is 3 + 8 = 11 and q + p is 8 + 3 = 11.

b.f5da72f6.de:
Ravi reads this number sentence about apples in a bag: a + 4 = 10. He says, “a stands for ‘apple’, so a means 1 apple.”
Explain what the letter a stands for.

tu_kiem.t: Kết luận: a đại diện cho một số (số quả táo), không phải chữ viết tắt của apple

b.f5da72f6.bai_mau: The letter a stands for a number, not for the word apple. Here a is the number of apples that makes the sentence true: 10 − 4 = 6, so a = 6 because 6 + 4 = 10.
